data.one_liner: Modular route management and dependency injection organized by feature.
data.what_it_does: Flutter Modular organizes Flutter applications into feature-based modules, combining route management and dependency injection. It allows scoping dependencies and routes per feature, supporting named routes, nested routers, and route guards.
use_when: You want to structure a large-scale Flutter application by features or modules.
You need nested routing with persistent shells using RouterOutlet.
You want integrated dependency injection tied to route lifecycles.
avoid_when: You are building a tiny app where a standard MaterialApp navigation setup is sufficient.
You prefer completely decoupled state management and routing solutions.
strengths: Combines dependency injection and routing cleanly into modules.
Automatic disposal of page-scoped state tied to route lifecycles.
Supports dynamic parameters, submodules, and route guards.
weaknesses: Opinionated structure that requires adopting its module pattern across the app.
Ground-up rewrite in v7 may require migration effort from older versions.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your root widget with ModularApp and configure MaterialApp.router to use the routerConfig.

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need standalone dependency injection without coupling to a specific routing architecture.
